technical.summary: MO shows strong bullish structure with price above all key moving averages and positive momentum indicators, but overbought RSI(9) and weak ADX trend strength combined with MACD divergence create pullback risk; moderate entry quality suitable for scaled positions with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: MO shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 83 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (16/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news sentiment limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (433), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent NFP event create severely adverse macro conditions despite low near-term earnings risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish confirmation and RSI momentum rising into overbought territory suggests continuation potential, while extreme fear (16/100) presents classic contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI(9) at 70.18, MACD bearish divergence, weak ADX trend strength (21.42), VIX crisis (433), unfavorable macro environment, zero fundamental conviction, and price trapped between tight support/resistance with BB squeeze severely limit upside and increase pullback risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure remains bullish with price above all major moving averages and supertrend confirmation, but overbought RSI(9) at 70.18 combined with MACD bearish divergence signals imminent pullback risk rather than continuation.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (433) and unfavorable macro environment (flat yield curve, rising dollar, NFP event) create systemic headwinds that override technical strength; overbought conditions with weak ADX trend strength (21.42) increase probability of mean reversion into support.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents show bullish structure but fundamental, sentiment, and risk agents all flag severe conviction gaps; debate winner (bear) reflects conflicting signals.
decision.portfolio_note: Existing MO position plus 6 other Consumer Staples holdings create sector concentration risk; skip new entry to avoid over-weighting low-volatility defensive exposure during macro crisis.
